edge_thesis: Betting on short-term continuation in broad U.S. equities, with a smaller gold position to diversify the exposure. The equity trade needs buyers to keep absorbing supply from short-term profit-takers; the gold trade needs safe-haven or allocation demand to outweigh selling from momentum traders. Both positions use defined exits to limit the cost of being wrong.

picks.why: Broad-market continuation with a defined stop; the target offers roughly twice the per-share risk.
A smaller, diversifying gold position with a defined exit if demand fades.
